firmwares.name: Real nff firmware — wired over USB (recommended)
firmwares.blurb: Zero-config: no WiFi needed. The device gets its network through the USB cable via this tab and comes online in YOUR project immediately. Add WiFi later to cut the cord.

firmwares.name: Real nff firmware — via your WiFi (advanced)
firmwares.blurb: Prefer WiFi from the start (or no Web Serial-friendly cable)? Enter your 2.4 GHz network's credentials; the device connects directly and no cable is needed after flashing.

firmwares.name: Demo blink (no fleet)
firmwares.blurb: Blinks the onboard LED + serial heartbeat. No WiFi, no certs — proof of flashing.
